epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Changeset correction · 2026-10-29T17:07Z

`Check Changeset` is red by design here (#18375, ruling D): this PR adds no changeset of its own and only corrects two pending release notes. Per `pr-automation.yml`'s route 0, `skip-changeset` is not applied and the red stays. The check is not required, and `pr-automation.yml` does not run on `merge_group`. The ADR-0087 and no-major steps on the same run are green ("adds no declared-breaking changeset"; "no `major` bump").

The notes and what changed under them:
- `.changeset/27277-plugin-driver-floor.md` (PR #27403): only the `Clause-②:` line changes, from `yes (…)` to `yes (narrowing) — …`. The level (`patch`), the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 marker are unchanged. Source: contract review 6502877381, ② should-fix.
- `.changeset/27425-phantom-owner-anchor-fails-closed.md` (PR #27476): the `Clause-②:` line changes from `no (narrowing)` to `yes (narrowing)`, and "Nothing is widened" becomes a sentence naming the widened `grant()` accept set. Nothing else changes. Source: contract review 6493803142, ② and ④ should-fix 2; seat ruling 6502747580.

This is the epic PM's own PR, so per pm-dispatch it waits on the maintainer's written confirmation before it lands.

epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Maintainer confirmation · 2026-10-29T19:39Z

The maintainer (田騏) confirmed this correction in writing in the epic PM's project thread at 2026-10-29T19:39Z: 「确认,由你落地」, in answer to "确认 #27671 这份 changeset 更正,可以带着 Check Changeset 的红落地吗?". The correction is as described in 6503280009. `Check Changeset` stays red by design (#18375). Every other check on `031abe85` is green or skipped. Landed by the seat through the relay.
